principles: v2 remains byte-for-byte live until the v3 substrate and every active-class canary are independently accepted
v3 is installed under disjoint paths, sockets, units, state directories, controller users, scale-set names, and runner prefixes
v2 and v3 project controllers are never active concurrently during migration because they do not share one physical-resource ledger
class canaries are executed one runner class at a time with every legacy project controller quiesced and no active legacy or v3 transient runner
production cutover of the currently active fleet is one generation boundary after all active-class canaries pass
research-engine GPU-derived classes remain installed-inactive and inherited-contained until separate recovery authority explicitly consumes legacy containment
catalog installation, controller activation, route admission, and legacy retirement are separate transitions

socket_authorization.root_authority: SO_PEERCRED numeric UID -> exactly one root-owned runner_class_id
socket_authorization.invariant: request JSON contains no authoritative runner_class_id selector

controller_identity.credential_policy: class users may share only repository-scoped GitHub observation credential groups; root launch authority remains per-UID/class
controller_identity.state_policy: each class controller owns a distinct 0700 state directory; no class controller can read or mutate another class ledger

generation_exclusion.reason: v2 and v3 provisioners maintain independent active/resource ledgers; simultaneous project-controller operation would create a physical-resource race
generation_exclusion.migration_rule: before any v3 controller becomes ACTIVE, stop all v2 project controllers and prove no legacy transient execution unit exists
generation_exclusion.canary_rule: during one-class canary, only the target v3 controller may be active
generation_exclusion.rollback_rule: stop target v3 controller, prove no v3 transient execution, then legacy v2 controllers may be resumed
generation_exclusion.final_cutover_rule: all legacy project controllers are quiesced and drained before active v3 production controllers are started
generation_exclusion.excluded_solution: do not add a cross-generation scheduler/lock broker solely to permit mixed-generation production operation

install_phase.name: V3_SUBSTRATE_INSTALL_INACTIVE
live_effect_if_eventually_authorized: create nine class controller Unix users and three project GitHub credential groups
install v3 binaries/config/catalog/projection schemas under disjoint v3 paths
install v3 systemd unit templates and tmpfiles
start root v3 provisioner/reconciler only after exact source and config attestation
do not start any v3 class controller
do not change any workflow runs-on label
do not change any v2 controller/service/scale set
do not clear research GPU containment
install_phase.success_state: v3 root services healthy; all target classes INSTALLED_INACTIVE; all target routes DISABLED

canary_strategy.event: workflow_dispatch or dedicated owner-only migration trigger
canary_strategy.repository_scope: canary lives in the owning repository because scale sets are repository-scoped
canary_strategy.policy: canary is compiled into a migration-only controller policy and never added to the ordinary executor action catalog
payload_rules: do not checkout or execute candidate PR code
verify expected GPU cardinality and exact visible UUID set
verify model/runtime mounts are present or absent exactly as class requires
verify payload network policy without widening it
verify project filesystem roots and forbidden paths
canary_strategy.precondition: all v2 project controllers stopped; no legacy/v3 transient runner active; target v3 class controller is the only active project controller
canary_strategy.postcondition: target v3 controller stopped after canary; no transient runner remains; v2 may be resumed if production cutover is not yet occurring

canary_order.rationale: legacy workspace-control controller is already inactive/contained; validates control-small and v3 control path without disturbing active scientific runners
active production class but CPU-only; lowest physical-resource risk after workspace-control v3 proof
validates GPU0-exclusive public class before active-fleet cutover

may be installed/canary-tested only if route/controller activation authority is separately explicit; exact-provenance route remains admission-disabled until legacy GPU containment migration is accepted

active_fleet_cutover.research_cpu: keep inactive unless separately authorized; installation/equivalence does not grant activation
transaction_order: verify no queued/in-progress migration transaction already exists
stop all legacy v2 project controllers
prove no legacy transient runner unit remains and old scale-set assigned/running counts are zero
prove v3 root/reconciler healthy and all target controllers inactive
atomically install trusted production workflow changes that retarget only accepted routes to their exact v3 scale-set names and update exact workflow pins/projections
start only accepted v3 class controllers
run one exact production validation per accepted class
prove TotalAssignedJobs returns to zero, runner-instance ledgers terminal/clean, no restart loop, and resource ledger empty
only then mark corresponding legacy controllers/scale sets DRAINING then RETIRED
active_fleet_cutover.failure_before_v3_job: restore workflow/policy generation, keep all v3 class controllers inactive, resume exact legacy v2 controllers
active_fleet_cutover.failure_after_v3_job_started: contain target v3 class, allow/force terminal cleanup, do not resume v2 until no v3 transient runner/resource claim remains, then restore old workflow generation and resume v2
active_fleet_cutover.rollback_invariant: never allow v2 and v3 project controllers to be active at the same time

workflow_cutover.rule: production route workflow runs-on changes from legacy scale-set name to target v3 class scale-set name only after class canary acceptance
workflow_cutover.atomic_policy_binding: workflow blob pin/controller projection/deployment overlay must bind the exact workflow commit before target route admission becomes ENABLED
workflow_cutover.no_fallback_label: do not encode v2/v3 fallback in runs-on; mixed-generation routing is intentionally forbidden

per_scale_set_preconditions: no active runner registration owned by legacy prefix
order: preserve old installed bytes/config/state for rollback window
delete/retire legacy scale set only after accepted v3 production proof
remove legacy controller config/state only in later cleanup task, not cutover transaction

research_gpu_containment.migration_default: target GPU-derived classes may be installed but controller_state stays INACTIVE and containment stays INHERITED_CONTAINED
research_gpu_containment.forbidden: catalog installation, v3 substrate activation, PADataset/workspace-control cutover, or class equivalence proof may not clear/consume/rewrite this authority
